The editor allows you to add or remove points in a visual graph. 
-> Right-click to add or remove points. Left-click to drag the graph or move points. 
-> Scroll to zoom. Hold shift to zoom horizontally. Hold ctrl to zoom vertically. 
-> The points are automatically sorted, meaning if you drag a point left or right past another point, it will move that point along with the one you are dragging.
